bugs.summary: The legacy RefResolver scope push is done unconditionally with id_of(self.schema), even when the schema has no id and id_of returns None. A None scope is pushed onto the resolver's scope stack, which corrupts later reference/pointer resolution.
bugs.trigger: Draft202012Validator(schema_without_$id, resolver=RefResolver('', schema)) with a '#/definitions/x' $ref: the pointer no longer resolves (issue #1124; fix pushes the scope only when id is not None).
